mission_08: The Document Object Model (DOM) is the browser's representation of your HTML page as a tree of JavaScript objects. DOM manipulation lets you dynamically change content, structure, and styles without reloading the page. Key methods include document.querySelector() for selecting elements, document.createElement() for creating new elements, appendChild() for adding elements to the tree, and addEventListener() for responding to user interactions. In this mission, you will build a complete todo list application using only vanilla DOM APIs.
